composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 (GMMS drawing 1905D023, sheet 2) is a BAE-system wiring/pin-mapping sheet for two BEL (inverter) converter units on the STBD side: BEL1-S and BEL2-S connector groups. Both groups' pin tables (I/O, FREQ_SELECT, VBATTERY RTN, CHAIN_OUTPUT, SYNC, ENABLE, ADR_0/1, CANA_HI/LO/Shield, CHAIN_SUPPLY) plus the associated BEL/RTN1, SYNC, and CAN-A connector blocks all name G3-S3xx nets for the left group and G3-S4xx nets for the right group — matching established BEL1-S / BEL2-S converter nodes (629-bel1-s, 629-bel2-s) already on the vessel's BAE system. No other equipment is named on this sheet.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: All pin labels in the left connector group are prefixed G3-S3xx and terminate in a BEL/RTN1, SYNC, and CAN-A connector block explicitly drawn above BEL1-S — matching the established BEL1-S converter node.

functions.label: Chain synchronization link (SYNC)
functions.sheet_region: upper-left (BEL/RTN1, SYNC 10/3 connector) and lower-left BEL1-S pin table
functions.what_it_does: Carries the twisted-pair synchronization signal between BEL1-S and the adjacent BEL unit in its inverter chain, keeping the paralleled inverters phase-locked; the paired return conductor closes the loop.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S pin 3 (G3-S3S2 SYNC) → SYNC connector terminal 3 → twisted pair (crossed on sheet) → SYNC connector terminal 10 → BEL/RTN1 connector pin 10; return via G3-S3R1 SYNC RTN wire-run from BEL1-S pin 7 (VBATTERY RTN) back to RTN1 connector

functions.dry_data: Signal-level twisted pair, no protective device shown; module: BEL1-S I/O connector, pins 3/7/10.

functions.label: CAN-A bus interconnect
functions.sheet_region: upper-left CAN-A connector and lower-left BEL1-S pin table
functions.what_it_does: Provides BEL1-S's differential CAN data link (HI/LO) with shield, used for monitoring/control communication on the BAE CAN-A bus.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S pin 5 (G3-S3AH CANA_HI) and pin 6 (G3-S3AL CANA_LO) → twisted shielded pair (crossed on sheet) → CAN-A connector HI/LO terminals; shield via G3-S3AS CANA_Shield to CAN-A connector Shield terminal

functions.dry_data: CAN differential bus, shielded pair; pins 5/6 + shield pin (marked N/C on lower connector position but routed to CAN-A Shield terminal).

functions.label: Chain configuration / addressing / enable
functions.what_it_does: Sets BEL1-S's operating configuration for the inverter chain: frequency selection, unit enable, and binary chain address, plus provides the chain output signal onward.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S pin 2 (G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT) — configuration input, far end not traced beyond connector
BEL1-S pin 1 (G3-S329 ENABLE) — far end marked N/C
BEL1-S pin 8 (G3-S300a ADR_0) and pin 9 (G3-S300b ADR_1) — far ends marked N/C
BEL1-S pin 11 (G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT) — onward chain signal, destination off-sheet

functions.dry_data: Configuration/address pins on BEL1-S I/O connector; ENABLE/ADR_0/ADR_1 far ends terminate N/C on this sheet.

functions.label: Chain supply feed
functions.what_it_does: Provides the BEL1-S chain supply connection; upstream source/protective device not shown on this sheet.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S pins 10/4 → G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY net — upstream source not identified on this sheet

functions.dry_data: Supply net label only; no breaker/fuse/rating shown.

uncertainties: Upstream source/protective device for G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY (BEL1-S) and G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY (BEL2-S) is not shown on this sheet — cannot identify breaker/fuse feeding these chain supplies.
Far-end destination of ENABLE, ADR_0, and ADR_1 lines for both BEL1-S and BEL2-S are marked N/C on this sheet — no active connection to trace.
Onward destination of CHAIN_OUTPUT (G3-S321 / G3-S421) beyond the connector pin is not shown on this sheet — likely continues to the next BEL unit in the chain but not drawn here.
